description.blurb: S/2019 S 20 is a natural satellite of Saturn, belonging to the Norse group. It was discovered in 2019 and announced in 2023.
description.more: S/2019 S 20 is about 3 kilometers in diameter and orbits Saturn at an average distance of 23.7 million km in 1375.45 days. It has an inclination of 156.1° to the ecliptic in a retrograde direction with an eccentricity of 0.354.
